//: FOREIGN NATIONS (docs/FOREIGN_NATIONS.md; the owner's direction). The Reach is one nation; these are the others, beyond the rim and off the map for now: the targets of its wars, in the mould of LOTGH's one strong neighbour and Rome's many. Each has a strength (hulls the Reach's expeditions must beat), a temper (aggressive nations raid the rim when their regard falls; mercantile ones trade and forgive; decaying ones crumble), a wealth (plunder a victory brings home), a distance (turns an expedition sails before it fights), a disposition toward the Reach, what it holds that the Reach wants, and the tribute it pays when subdued. The Senate makes war by motion; houses send expeditions; score beyond `threshold` subdues the nation for twenty turns. `exports` are what a nation ships into the Reach's markets a turn while at peace and not hostile (docs/ECONOMY_MARKET.md): war or a regard of -30 closes its ports, and a subdued nation ships double.

nations.name: The Ardent Concord
nations.holds: the Ardent gate and three forge-worlds
nations.description: The one strong neighbour: a unified state under a council of admirals, with a fleet the size of half the Reach's and a habit of raiding the rim when the Reach looks divided. Beating it would make a general's name for a generation.

nations.name: The Free Cities of Thessar
nations.holds: the richest exchanges beyond the rim and a belt of rare earths
nations.description: A league of trading cities that would rather buy than fight. Rich, lightly armed, quick to pay tribute and quicker to stop when the fleets go home.

nations.name: The Vashti Khanates
nations.holds: the lanes the raiders use, and little else worth taking
nations.description: Horse-lords of the void: a dozen khans who raid the rim for crews and cargo and unite only when someone comes for them. Easy to beat in a season; impossible to hold.

nations.name: The Outer Compact
nations.holds: deep deposits of isotopes under four small worlds
nations.description: Small, far, and sitting on the isotopes every arsenal in the Reach wants. It fights only when invaded, and then well.

nations.name: The Hollow Crown
nations.holds: the treasuries and titles of an empire that was
nations.description: An old empire past its strength, all ceremony and debt. Its fleets are fewer every decade; its vaults are not. The first general to break it will come home very rich.
